guideContent.strategyOverview: This upgrade transforms Endless Punishment from a casual Bracket 1-2 precon into a focused Bracket 3 group slug powerhouse. We're removing underperformers and slow lands while adding damage multipliers, a late-game infinite combo, and a premium mana base. The Lord of Pain rewards you for dealing damage to opponents with card draw and life drain, making damage multiplication effects extremely powerful.

budget.name: Death by a Thousand Cuts
budget.subtitle: Consistent Pings, Maximum Card Draw
budget.description: Ultra-budget upgrade focused on Valgavoth as commander. Every card reliably triggers Valgavoth on opponents' turns for consistent card draw and commander growth. Cheap enchantments and creatures that ping each upkeep form a damage engine, while fakeout death effects protect your commander on a budget. No expensive lands or damage doublers needed -- just relentless, unavoidable pain.

Every card is chosen to reliably ping opponents on THEIR turns for guaranteed card draw. Protection suite keeps Valgavoth alive as a growing flying threat that wins through commander damage or overwhelming card advantage. Includes radiation counters as a unique angle for persistent damage.

full.name: Eternal Agony
full.description: Maximum power group slug. Deal damage to all opponents whenever anyone does anything. 7 Game Changers (plus Vampiric Tutor in base = 8 total) power a devastating engine of damage multipliers, punisher enchantments, and instant-speed interaction. Combos are included when pieces independently support the theme. Aggressive 40-card swaps replace every underperformer and slow land with premium options.

synergies.title: Wound Reflection + Group Slug
synergies.description: Havoc Festival halves life, Wound Reflection doubles that loss at end step = lethal in a single turn cycle. Math: 40 life → Festival loses 20 → Wound Reflection: lost 20, lose 20 more → 0 = dead.

synergies.title: Heartless Hidetsugu + Damage Doubler
synergies.description: Activate to deal half life to each player. With any doubler (Solphim/Dictate/Fiery Emancipation) = lethal to all players at even life. Survive by being at odd life total or winning in response to the trigger.

synergies.title: Draw Punishment Package
synergies.description: Each normal opponent draw = 5 life reduction: Sheoldred 2 life loss + Dreams 1 damage + Unraveler 1 damage + Parasite 1 damage. With Solphim: 8 per draw (Sheoldred's life loss NOT doubled — only damage doubled, so 2 + 2 + 2 + 2 = 8). Three opponents drawing 1 card = 24 per turn cycle. Orcish Bowmasters adds +1 damage per EXTRA draw beyond first. Wound Reflection / Archfiend of Despair double ALL life loss at end step.
